verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page claims native "CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically." Its webhook API exposes an `include_crm_matches` option, which suggests meetings are matched to CRM records. The evidence is thin marketing copy, though: it never names HubSpot, Salesforce or Attio, and never documents how notes and summaries attach to specific contact and deal records. Missing for 10: named support for HubSpot, Salesforce and Attio; documentation of automatic association to contact and deal records; explicit sync of notes and summaries (not just fields); independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)

citations.quote: CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically
At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.
